title: Kestrel and the Regiment
author: Freya Eastwick
blurb: Gideon Crane, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
